Employment Act 1968 (preamble text that must be ignored)

# 10. Termination of contract
Either party may terminate a contract of service by giving notice of termination in writing.

# 38. Hours of work
An employee shall not be required to work more than 8 hours a day or 44 hours in a week.
Overtime is paid at 1.5 times the hourly basic rate of pay.

# 88. Annual leave
An employee who has served for 3 months is entitled to paid annual leave of 7 days in the first year.
